title: BOFT logical expert views
hypothesis: A shared nonlinear expert plus shared butterfly angle atom and small expert scalar codes recovers routed logical expert functions with lower actual bytes than independent BOFT experts and improves on hard tying, IA3, and rank-one modulation.
mirror_coordinate: One scalar code per expert multiplying a shared 4x8 butterfly angle atom at the hidden activation interface

task.router: oracle IDs supplied equally to all methods
task.metric: mean and worst expert held-out MSE

controls: shared butterfly atom plus Mirror expert codes

development.selection_metric: mean heldout MSE across methods and worlds

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent; payload <=60% independent; and >=10% lower MSE than BOFT and rank-one at byte-near storage or lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or a simpler control matches at equal/lower bytes.
boundaries: oracle router supplied; learned routing not evaluated
teacher deliberately factorized via shared butterfly atom
fixed-update screen not a capacity proof
